name: Boat Pose Arm Pulses

instructions.description: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Lean your torso back slightly, keeping your spine long and your chest open.

Engage your core and lift your feet off the floor. Extend your legs as much as comfortably possible and bring your torso and thighs into a V-shaped position. Extend your arms forward at about shoulder height.
Hold the Boat position while making small, controlled pulses with your arms up and down. Keep the movement small and maintain a steady, stable torso.
Continue for the desired duration while breathing steadily and keeping your core engaged.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.

relationships.note: Maintains boat pose without the added arm pulses.

commentsNotes: Keep your chest lifted and spine long; avoid rounding your lower back.
Keep your core engaged to maintain the V position.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.
Prioritize a stable Boat position over the number or speed of arm pulses.
If needed, keep your knees bent to make the exercise easier.
